'''2006 Massachusetts State Championship''' was a Star Wars CCG state championship in Massachusetts (1 July 2006). It is known from the decklists below, recovered from DeckTech posts and Players Committee forms.

== Format ==

* '''Environment:''' [[Premiere - Original VS6]] (from the card pool legal on the event date)
* '''Site:''' Massachusetts
* '''Dates:''' 1 July 2006
* '''Venue:''' Scholar's Books and Games, 34 Central Square, Bridgewater, Massachusetts<ref name="sf-10118-139758">[https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?p=139758#p139758 MA/RI States Weekend, Potential CT States as well], Michael Pistone (Pistone84), Star Wars CCG Players Committee Forums, forum.starwarsccg.org (4 June 2006).</ref>
* '''Tournament director:''' [[Michael Pistone]]<ref name="sf-10118-139758" />
* '''Structure:''' constructed, six-game Swiss with a final confrontation; decklists required, no clear sleeves; $10 entry, registration from 11 am, start at 12<ref name="sf-10118-139758" />
* '''Prizes:''' uncut sheets and tournament foils; the top player received a bye to Day 2 of the World Championship<ref name="sf-10118-139758" />
